ja.summary: 著者：白広達 編集者：白亜州 7月25日の朝、杭州網易公園の講堂は人でいっぱいだった。 20 チーム以上が講堂に座り、48 時間にわたるオフライン ゲームの極限の開発に備えました。彼らのほとんどは数時間前に初めてチームメイトに会った。多くのチームがオンラインでチームを結成し、オフラインで「会う」前に決勝戦に進出しました。長い開会の挨拶もなく、プロデューサーのシャオ・ハンは直接ステージに上がり、この決勝戦のテーマ「隠された（cáng/zàng）」を明らかにした。 4 つの意味を持つ 1 つの漢字が、隠れたり、景色を集めたり、秘密の場所にある宝物や世界など、若い開発者の想像力の出発点となっています。 「MINI ゲーム、無限の愛」をスローガンとするこの大学の MINI-GAME チャレンジは、ゲーム開発の完全なリンクを 1 つの夏に凝縮します。長年ゲームレポーターやゲームジャムの審査員を務めてきた私は、48 時間かかる提案の開発プロセスをよく知っています。

en.title: Writing the word "hidden" into a game: 48 hours in the life of a group of college young people
en.summary: Author: Bai Guangda Editor: Bai Yazhou On the morning of July 25, the lecture hall of Hangzhou NetEase Park was full of people. More than twenty teams sat in the lecture hall, preparing for a 48-hour offline game extreme development. Most of them met their teammates for the first time a few hours ago. Many teams formed an online team and reached the finals before "meeting" offline. Without a lengthy opening speech, producer Xiao Han went directly to the stage to reveal the theme of this final: Hidden (cáng/zàng). One Chinese character with four meanings has become the starting point for the imagination of young developers: hiding, collecting scenery, treasures in secret places, or a world. This college MINI-GAME challenge with the slogan "MINI Games, Infinite Love" compresses the complete link of game development into one summer. As a game reporter and Game Jam judge for many years, I know very well the 48-hour proposition development process.

You must know that people all over the world were forced to stay at home and pass the time through games. At the same time, it almost equaled the full-year performance of 2021 (USD 11.4 billion). The recovery momentum of the local market is particularly obvious, with a year-on-year increase of 17% to 47.3 billion yuan, which is also one of the strongest performances in a single quarter in recent years. Revenue from the international market was 18.6 billion yuan, a slight decrease in nominal terms due to exchange rates, but an increase of 4% based on fixed exchange rates. It is reported that local growth is mainly driven by four products: "Delta Operation", "Dauntless Contract", "Dauntless Contract: Operation Source Energy" and "Rock Kingdom: World". Among them, the average number of daily active accounts of "Operation Delta" and "Fearless Contract" both hit record highs this quarter. Tencent said that "Honor of Kings" took advantage of the May 5th Black Festival and the linkage with "Nezha 2" to maintain its user base, while "Operation Delta" increased its daily active users to a record high through successive versions of S9 and S10. zh.title: 用户抱怨给克劳德添加人工智能水印可能会暴露他们在工作或学校使用人工智能
zh.summary: 根据欧盟执行的立法，Anthropic 决定在人工智能生成的内容中添加“水印”。一些人工智能用户抗议这一决定。阅读更多...

en.title: Users complain that adding AI watermarks to Claude may reveal that they are using AI at work or school
en.summary: Based on the legislation enforced in the EU, Anthropic has decided to add a "watermark" to the content generated by AI. Some AI users are protesting this decision. read more...

items.title: TwitchがコンテンツをAmazonのAIトレーニングに利用すると公表、利用されたくないユーザー向けにオプトアウト設定を追加
items.summary: 動画配信プラットフォームのTwitchが、コンテンツをAmazonのAIトレーニングに利用していく方針を明らかにしました。トレーニングに利用されたくないユーザー向けにオプトアウトするための設定が設けられています。続きを読む...

zh.title: Twitch 宣布内容将用于亚马逊的 AI 培训，并为不想使用的用户添加了选择退出设置

en.title: Twitch announces that content will be used for Amazon's AI training, adds opt-out setting for users who do not want to be used
en.summary: Video distribution platform Twitch has announced that it will use its content for Amazon's AI training. There is an opt-out setting for users who do not want to be used for training. read more...

items.title: イルカが「貝殻」を使って魚を捕らえる技術を母から子へ伝えている可能性
items.summary: オーストラリア北東部のクイーンズランド州沖に生息するミナミハンドウイルカが、「貝殻を使って魚を捕らえる技術」を持っていることが初めて確認されました。さらに、「shelling(シェリング)」と呼ばれるこの狩りの技術が、イルカの母親から子どもに伝えられている可能性もあるとのことです。続きを読む...

zh.title: 海豚将使用“贝壳”捕鱼的技术从母亲传给后代的可能性
zh.summary: 首次证实生活在澳大利亚东北部昆士兰州海岸附近的南方宽吻海豚具有利用贝壳捕鱼的能力。此外，这种被称为“脱壳”的狩猎技术有可能是从海豚母亲那里遗传给它们的孩子的。阅读更多...

en.title: Possibility that dolphins transmit the technique of catching fish using ``shells'' from mother to offspring
en.summary: It has been confirmed for the first time that the southern bottlenose dolphin, which lives off the coast of Queensland in northeastern Australia, has the ability to catch fish using shells. Furthermore, there is a possibility that this hunting technique called ``shelling'' is passed down from dolphin mothers to their children. read more...

items.title: 「Grok 4.6」が登場、長時間のエージェント作業に強くなりGPT-5.6 SolやClaude Fable 5と並ぶ性能に

zh.title: 「Grok 4.6」现已上市，性能堪比 GPT-5.6 Sol 和 Claude Fable 5，对抗长期代理工作能力强劲

en.title: "Grok 4.6" is now available, with performance comparable to GPT-5.6 Sol and Claude Fable 5, which is strong against long-term agent work
en.summary: SpaceXAI announced the AI ​​model "Grok 4.6" on August 12, 2026. It is based on Grok 4.5 and represents significant improvements at the same price, with a focus on long-running AI agent work and more advanced interactive visual processing. read more...
